components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid red CTA — the system's highest-intent control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; background: #e01e24; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #b01820; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(224,30,36,0.4); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent secondary CTA that fills the same footprint as the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; background: transparent; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 10px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: #e01e24; color: #e01e24; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Footer Pill CTA
components.description: Direct-contact pill button — the one place buttons take full-pill radius instead of 10px.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill-phone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #e01e24; background: rgba(224,30,36,0.10); border: 2px solid rgba(224,30,36,0.35); border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-pill-phone:hover, .ds-btn-pill-phone:focus-visible { background: #e01e24; border-color: #e01e24; color: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(224,30,36,0.32); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest card that lifts with a neutral shadow and red-tinted border on hover.
components.html:
Brake Services

Full brake system inspection, pad and disc replacement, caliper servicing and brake fluid changes.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #171717; border: 1px solid #242424; border-radius: 10px; padding: 36px 30px; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: rgba(224,30,36,0.35); transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #9a9a9a; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark-filled field with a red focus ring; no border-width change on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a9a9a; } .ds-field-input { background: #111111; border: 1px solid #242424; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #484848; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #e01e24; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224,30,36,0.1); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase, tracked-out Big Shoulders Display link with a color-only hover state; .active marks the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #cccccc; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link.active { color: #e01e24; }

components.name: Hero Stat Cell
components.description: Dashboard-style readout cell used in the hero stat bar — the system's most concentrated trust signal.
components.css: .ds-stat { flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 24px 16px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); } .ds-stat-num { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #e01e24; line-height: 1; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a9a9a; margin-top: 6px; }

narrative.overview: Tech-Mech reads as a workshop instrument panel, not a marketing brochure: a near-black canvas (#0d0d0d) that recedes so completely that the single accent — Diagnostic Red (#e01e24) — reads with the authority of a warning light on a scan tool. The system is industrial and disciplined: condensed uppercase Big Shoulders Display headings, generous 120px section rhythm, flat dark-on-darker card surfaces distinguished by hairline borders rather than shadows, and controls that stay quiet until touched. Confidence comes from control, not noise — the palette never competes with the red, and the red never appears without reason (a CTA, a stat, an active state, a safety cue). No anti-reference has been confirmed yet; this system should keep favoring instrument-panel restraint over decorative flourish as it's extended.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with a single, disciplined red signal color
Condensed, uppercase Big Shoulders Display for anything structural (headings, labels, nav, buttons)
Flat surfaces at rest; depth and red-tinted glow appear only as hover feedback
Generous, consistent 120px vertical section rhythm; tight, precise component padding
A dedicated logo typeface (Barlow Condensed) that never leaks into body UI

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Diagnostic Red is the only color allowed to mean "act here" or "this matters now." If something new needs emphasis, it earns red or it doesn't get emphasis — it does not get a second accent color.

rules.name: The All-Caps Structure Rule
rules.body: Anything that is structural chrome rather than reading content — nav, buttons, labels, section eyebrows, stat labels — is Big Shoulders Display, uppercase, and tracked out. Anything meant to be read at length is Montserrat, sentence case, untracked.

rules.name: The Earned-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. Shadows exist only as feedback for an action just taken (hover) or an action available (a primary control) — never as decoration.

rules.name: The Container-vs-Pill Rule
rules.body: 10px radius means "this holds content." Full-pill/circle radius means "this is a badge, a person, or a direct contact action." The two never swap roles.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker/eyebrow label sits above a section heading. The heading carries its own weight — delete the label rather than adding one back, even when a reference layout uses one.

dos: Do keep Diagnostic Red to signal-carrying elements only (CTAs, active states, key numbers) — never a background fill for large areas.
Do use 10px radius for anything that holds content, and reserve full-pill/circle radius for badges, avatars, and direct-contact buttons.
Do let shadows appear only in response to hover or on the highest-intent controls — nothing casts a shadow at rest.
Do keep Big Shoulders Display uppercase for structural chrome (nav, buttons, labels) and Montserrat sentence-case for anything meant to be read at length.
Do center and cap section intro headers (Services, Gallery, Reviews) at 640px, with a responsive gap before the grid (clamp(48px, 6vw, 64px)).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color alongside Diagnostic Red — new emphasis needs earn red or don't get emphasis.
Don't use Barlow Condensed anywhere outside the logo wordmark.
Don't add resting shadows to cards or panels — depth is earned through interaction, not applied by default.
Don't give a content-holding container a pill or circular radius, or a badge/avatar a 10px radius — the two corner languages must stay separate.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a section heading.
